hypothesis: tl.dot(a, b.T) on host descriptors reads B down its columns through the LSU (one 8-byte beat per element pair, heavy LSU stalls). A transposed tensor-DMA write (ISA sec 9E mod[5]) lets the engine deliver B^T straight into the MMA fragment window, cutting memory beats and LSU stalls on the GEMM inner loop.
evidence_for_hypothesis: smoke GEMM fp16 16x16x32 on core-sim: 13549 cycles, 3156 memory beats for 2560 required bytes (9.9x), perf_x_lsu 21.8% of cycles, matrix unit <= 0.5% busy (doc/r38_stage1_status.md)

microarch.change: transposed write via a 16 x 8-byte corner-turn buffer (S_XRUN/S_XDRAIN/S_XWRITE); elaboration parameter HAS_TENSOR_XPOSE; mod[5] without it and any non-zero mod[4:3] raise ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION (previously ignored)

isa.change: sec 9E defines the transposed layout and its geometry (16-bit, 4/8/16 source rows); capability tensor_transpose derived from HAS_TENSOR_XPOSE; profile core-xpose-v1 (executes_artifacts_of core-sim)

compiler.change: _plan_transposes: a 16-bit descriptor load used only by tt.trans, in the same block with no intervening write, is deferred and emitted at the trans as one t.ld.async.h.t (host descriptors included); otherwise the gathered lowering is unchanged

runtime.change: loader rule check_executes: a core-xpose-v1 artifact on core-sim is CAPABILITY_MISSING naming tensor_transpose; core-sim artifacts run on core-xpose-v1

compatibility.feature_off_artifacts: byte-identical to the frozen baseline for all 149 O2 cases on core-sim
compatibility.old_artifacts_on_new_hardware: core-sim artifact runs on core-xpose-v1 with baseline cycles
compatibility.geometry: a descriptor consumed by the transposed transfer that violates sec 9E.2 (e.g. a 36-byte row stride) traps DESCRIPTOR_FAULT on core-xpose-v1; the same kernel runs on core-sim through the LSU. The frozen v1 manifest has no field to declare which descriptors the engine reads, so the runtime cannot pre-check it.

resource.note: a first version accepting 1/2/4-byte elements at any offset cost +50958 gates (+120%); narrowing to 16-bit elements and replicating the row across the register (lane enables place it) cut that to +4734

results.timing: serial-grid device cycles, O2, fast memory model
results.unchanged: every other R37 case; FP32/FP8 GEMM, 3-D batched and 4-D attention descriptors do not meet the transposed-write rule and keep the gathered lowering
results.correctness: R37 447/447 on core-sim (cycles identical to the baseline at O0/O1/O2) and 447/447 on core-xpose-v1; 12 partial-tile FP16/BF16 GEMMs; 224 lane assertions (t30_xpose)

rollback: build without HAS_TENSOR_XPOSE (every pre-R38 profile): artifacts and cycles are the baseline's and the engine's structural proxy is the parent's within 0.1% gates/flops
